Arvaya Healthcare Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 04/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. To consider and approve the proposed objects and utilisation of proceeds of the Rights Issue, including the proposed deployment of funds towards the objects set out in the Draft Letter of Offer.
2. To consider and approve the Draft Letter of Offer ('DLOF') in connection with the proposed Rights Issue and to authorise the necessary filings and submissions with the BSE Limited and other regulatory authorities, as applicable.
3. To consider and approve the proposed material related party transactions with various related parties of the Company subject to the recommendations of the Audit Committee and approval of the shareholders, wherever applicable, in accordance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
